title: A Well for the Harvest
author: Gideon Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Vasquez, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
